scripts.android: bash -c 'export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; if [ -f /opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem ]; then export SSL_CERT_FILE=/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem SSL_CERT_DIR=/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/certs; elif [ -f /usr/local/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem ]; then export SSL_CERT_FILE=/usr/local/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem SSL_CERT_DIR=/usr/local/etc/openssl@3/certs; fi; exec ./node_modules/.bin/expo run:android'
scripts.ios: bash -c 'export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; if [ -f /opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem ]; then export SSL_CERT_FILE=/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem SSL_CERT_DIR=/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/certs; elif [ -f /usr/local/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem ]; then export SSL_CERT_FILE=/usr/local/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem SSL_CERT_DIR=/usr/local/etc/openssl@3/certs; fi; exec ./node_modules/.bin/expo run:ios'
scripts.ios:pods: bash -lc 'cd ios && export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" && if [ -f /opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem ]; then export SSL_CERT_FILE=/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem SSL_CERT_DIR=/opt/homebrew/etc/openssl@3/certs; elif [ -f /usr/local/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem ]; then export SSL_CERT_FILE=/usr/local/etc/openssl@3/cert.pem SSL_CERT_DIR=/usr/local/etc/openssl@3/certs; fi && pod install'
